citation.title: Hypoglycemia compensation mechanisms in dry fasting

reported.what: serum glucose, serum insulin and plasma glucagon over 5 days of dry fasting (no food or water), mean +/- SE (SD in parentheses), n = 10, Days 0, 2, 3, 5 (Table 3; some later columns are changes from Day 0)
Day 0 fasting-free baseline insulin, habitual nutrition, sampled at the end of a 20:00-to-20:00 day interval, so not a timed fast

detail: Every fasting sample is taken during a fast with no water for 1 to 5 days, which the protocol cannot express, and the only pre-fast values (Day 0) are drawn at the end of a day on habitual nutrition at an unstated clock time, so they are neither fasted nor timed fed samples.
